source: BIAVGit/Morimens-Localizations (MapNodeType rows); entries marked ai / game+ai are AI-assisted

combat.dz: 一些不期而遇的敌人，会触发一场战斗。
combat.de: Some unexpected enemies will trigger a battle.

elite.dz: 一些略有挑战的敌人，会触发一场稍难的战斗。
elite.de: Some moderately challenging enemies will trigger a tougher battle.

boss.dz: 最终，亦是最强的敌人，击败后将结束这场调查。
boss.de: Ultimately, the strongest enemy. Defeat them to conclude this investigation.

event.dz: 危险还是机遇，取决于你的抉择。
event.de: Danger or opportunity, the choice is yours.

bones.dz: 一截苍白的骸骨，半数浸没于漆黑的融蚀浆中
bones.de: A section of pale bone, half-submerged in black D-Slime

ash-ruins.dz: 利莫利亚沉没的遗迹，其后的存在渴求着用神秘力量交换你手中的黑印。
ash-ruins.de: The sunken ruins of Limoria, where the presence behind them desires to exchange mysterious powers for Black Sigil in your hands.

black-seal.dz: 获得黑印——一种在幻梦空间中的通行货币。
black-seal.de: Gain Black Sigil, a currency in Dreamscape.

locked-door.dz: 沉默矗立的坚固门扉。需要使用锈蚀钥匙开启。
locked-door.de: A sturdy, silent door. Requires a Rusted Key to open.

rusted-key.dz: 它耐心地寻找着属于它的那一扇门扉。
rusted-key.de: It patiently searches for its Door.

illusion.dz: 扭曲的幻象阻挡了你的前进，若选择破除，将会感染未知的症状。
illusion.de: A twisted illusion blocks your path; choosing to break it will infect you with an unknown symptom

lamp.dz: 前人遗留下来的照明装置，可驱散四周的浓雾。
lamp.de: An ancient lighting device that can dispel the surrounding thick fog.

passage-in.dz: 一条有去无回的不稳定通路，进入后将无法从出口折返。
passage-in.de: An unstable one-way path; once entered, there is no way to return from the exit.

passage-out.dz: 单行密道的出口，内部已经坍缩，无法从此处折返回密道入口。
passage-out.de: The One-Way Passage's exit. It has already collapsed, making it impossible to go back.

tunnel.dz: 漆黑的道路通向未知，进入后将传送至通道的另一端。
tunnel.de: The pitch-black road leads to the unknown, and upon entry, it will transport you to the other end of the passage.

unstable-floor.dz: 不牢固的地板（官方只给出名称）。推测踏过后可能塌陷，无法折返。
unstable-floor.de: Unstable Floor (the game only gives the name). Presumably it can collapse after being crossed, so you may not be able to go back.

normal.dz: 没有特殊效果的可通行节点。
normal.de: A walkable node without special effects.

poison-floor.dz: 紫色格子。游戏内没有官方说明，推测为带有毒气效果的危险地面，经过前请留意。
poison-floor.de: Purple tile. No official description exists; presumably a hazardous floor with a poison-gas effect, so be careful when crossing it.
